properties.name: valueMissingLabel
properties.defaultValue: Please select at least one option
properties.description:
Localized constraint-validation message shown when `required` is unmet.
`errorText` still wins when set, so an app-supplied inline message and the
native bubble stay in agreement.

properties.name: reserveSupportingSpace
properties.description:
Always occupy the supporting-text line, even when there is no message, so a
validation error does not push the content below it down. Forwarded to the
embedded md-text-field. See that component for why it is opt-in.

properties.name: variant
properties.description: Visual variant — forwarded to the inner `md-text-field`.

properties.name: label
properties.description: Floating label / accessible name.

properties.name: placeholder
properties.description: Placeholder shown when nothing is selected.

properties.name: supportingText
properties.description: Supporting / helper text below the field.

properties.name: error
properties.description: Error state — forwarded to the inner field.

properties.name: errorText
properties.description: Error text rendered in place of supporting text when `error` is set.

properties.name: disabled
properties.description: Disabled — non-interactive.

properties.name: softDisabled
properties.description: Soft-disabled — disabled visuals but still focusable.

properties.name: required
properties.description: Required (form validation parity).

properties.name: density
properties.description: Density forwarded to the inner field.

properties.name: options
properties.description:
Programmatic options. Slotted `md-select-option` children take precedence.

Accepts the array (property) or a **JSON string** (attribute), so a
plain-HTML page can declare its data inline instead of reaching for a
script. Malformed JSON degrades to an empty list with a console warning.

properties.name: virtualize
properties.description:
Virtualization mode for large option lists (backed by a WASM data engine):
  - `'auto'` (default): virtualize only above `VIRTUALIZE_THRESHOLD` rows.
  - `'always'`: always virtualize.
  - `'never'`: keep the classic DOM rendering.
Virtualized rows render label + selection only (no per-row icon /
supporting text), assume a uniform row height, and disable "Select all".

properties.name: filterable
properties.description: Show a search field in the menu header that filters via the WASM engine.

properties.name: filterMode
properties.description: Filter strategy used by `filterable` / `setQuery`.

properties.name: rowHeight
properties.description: Fixed virtualized row height (px). Auto-measured from the first row if unset.

properties.name: value
properties.description: Currently selected values.

properties.name: maxSelected
properties.description: Maximum number of selected items. `0` = unlimited.

properties.name: showSelectAll
properties.description: Render an inline "Select all" checkbox at the top of the menu.

properties.name: selectAllLabel
properties.description: Label for the "Select all" item.

properties.name: placement
properties.description: Menu placement relative to the trigger — forwarded to `md-menu`.

properties.name: maxHeight
properties.description:
Max height of the dropdown menu (px), forwarded to `md-menu`. Virtualized
lists fall back to 320 when unset (they need a bounded scroll viewport).

properties.name: matchTriggerWidth
properties.description:
Match the dropdown width to the trigger. When `false` the menu sizes to
content. Maps to `md-menu`'s `match-anchor-width`. Default `true`.

properties.name: displayMode
properties.description:
How selected values appear in the trigger:
  - `'chips'` (default): removable chips in a region BELOW the field.
  - `'chips-inline'`: removable chips INSIDE the trigger input, on a single
    line — the field keeps its normal height and never grows; chips that
    overflow are clipped (the open menu is the source of truth).
  - `'count'`: "{n} selected".
  - `'text'`: comma-joined labels.

properties.name: chipOverflow
properties.description:
For `display-mode="chips-inline"`, how the in-field chips handle running out
of room:
  - `'count'` (default): chips stay on ONE line; the field keeps its normal
    height and the chips that don't fit collapse into a trailing `+N` counter
    chip (click it — or the field — to open the menu and manage the full set).
  - `'wrap'`: chips wrap onto new rows and the field grows to fit them.

properties.name: chipPosition
properties.description:
Where the removable chips sit relative to the trigger, for `display-mode="chips"`
(ignored for `chips-inline`/`count`/`text`): `'bottom'` (default), `'top'`,
`'left'`, or `'right'`. `left`/`right` place the chips beside the trigger and are
the natural pairing for `trigger="button"`.

properties.name: trigger
properties.description:
Trigger style: `'field'` (default) is the readonly md-text-field; `'button'` is
a compact button (leading icon + label) that only opens the drawer — the
selection shows as removable chips beside it (pair with `chip-position`
`left`/`right`). The button always shows chips regardless of `display-mode`.

properties.name: triggerIcon
properties.description: Leading icon (Material Symbol name) for `trigger="button"`.

properties.name: triggerLabel
properties.description: Button text for `trigger="button"`. Falls back to `label`.

properties.name: countFormatter
properties.description: Custom formatter for `display-mode="count"`.

properties.name: searchPlaceholder
properties.description: Placeholder for the filter search input (localization).

properties.name: filterLabel
properties.description: Accessible label for the filter search input. Defaults to "Filter {label}".

properties.name: noResultsText
properties.description: Text shown when the filter matches no options (localization).

properties.name: noOptionsText
properties.description: Text shown when there are no options at all (localization).

properties.name: searchingLabel
properties.description: Accessible label for the search spinner (localization).

properties.name: loadingText
properties.description: Text shown in the trigger / menu while `loading` is true.

properties.name: loading
properties.description:
Show a busy state: the trigger shows a spinner instead of the caret and the
host is `aria-busy`, and the menu shows a wavy progress bar instead of the
option list. Use while an async dataset loads (e.g. before/around a large
`loadOptions`). Replace the trigger spinner with the `loader` slot.

properties.name: clearable
properties.description: Show a clear (×) button in the trigger that removes all selections.

properties.name: clearIcon
properties.description: Material Symbols glyph for the clear button.

properties.name: clearLabel
properties.description: Accessible label for the clear button (localization).

properties.name: dropdownIcon
properties.description:
Caret glyph (Material Symbol) for the field trigger; rotates 180° when open.
Override the whole glyph with the `dropdown-icon` slot.

properties.name: name
properties.description: Form name. Selected values submit as repeated `name=value` pairs.

properties.name: open
properties.description: Open state of the menu. Reflected so `:host([open])` rules apply.

attributes.value:
{
          'md-multi-select': true,
          [`md-multi-select--${this.variant}`]: true,
          'md-multi-select--open': this.open,
          'md-multi-select--disabled': this.disabled,
          'md-multi-select--soft-disabled': this.softDisabled,
          'md-multi-select--loading': this.loading,
          [`md-multi-select--display-${this.displayMode}`]: true,
          'md-multi-select--button': this.trigger === 'button' && !this.hasSlottedTrigger,
          'md-multi-select--slotted-trigger': this.hasSlottedTrigger,
          [`md-multi-select--chips-${this.chipPosition}`]:
            this.trigger === 'button' ||
            this.hasSlottedTrigger ||
            this.displayMode === 'chips',
        }

name: Multi Select
description: Pick several values from a list. Everything md-select does, plus multiple selection shown as removable chips / a count / plain text, an optional select-all row, a selection cap, and a field, button or fully custom trigger.

notes: Selection supports chips, remove, clear, disabled options and maximum count; count/text layout and anchor placement differ.

Native Material/Compose appearance; CSS selectors, DOM APIs, form association, cancelable DOM events and source imperative methods are not compiled. Unsupported source properties are reported by the compiler.
